sources.observation: Actually read the graph lesson, complete example, adjoining practice and Key Ideas including closing line 538, and inspected actual images3 and4. Image3 demonstrates both time-to-interest and interest-to-time tracing. Its coarse graph reads about $320 at three years, while the stated 2000 at 5.3% gives exact interest $318; its $530 at five years agrees. Image4 shows the 7% graph and practice readings $280 at four years and about 5.7 years at $400. Scoped repair re-read the complete prepared graph excerpt and inspected actual original image3 again: it explicitly demonstrates upward time-to-interest then leftward tracing, and rightward interest-to-time then downward tracing. The independent reviewer actual PNG finding on q10 was also inspected; proposed placement remains subject to fresh canonical pixels.
sources.adjustments: WorkedExamples[4] adapts the available worked graph with interest $90 per year, an editable native graph using $100 labelled intervals and $10 grid spacing, and exact readable tasks at (3,270) and (5,450). These replace the source approximate $320/$530 readings with unambiguous $270/$450 readings. This comes from the original worked graph, not a copied published practice card. All existing site graph coordinates, questions, values and text remain unchanged; four vertical reading guides in Foundation[10], Development[9], Mastery[2] and quiz q7 now point upward from time to the line. Quiz q10 answer label4.5 moves from the tick-label row to above/right of the time-guide endpoint, preserving ordinary tick labels, guide directions and the correct4.5-year result. Quiz q10 distractor $275 is two $25 grid intervals above $225, not one. Actual rendering is still required. Quiz q10 distractor2.25 now explicitly describes assuming $100 interest per year, which reproduces the wrong value.

sources.locator: Find time by substituting then solving
sources.observation: Actually read the complete time example including closing line 677. The taught order is write I=Prn, substitute givens, simplify to 1386=231n and solve n=6. This is supported by the actual prerequisite theory: substitute first rather than rearranging the general formula.
sources.adjustments: WorkedExamples[2](a) preserves the time example values and the formula-substitute-simplify-solve order, with concise complete equation lines. Time-to-month conversion is retained where requested in practice.

sources.observation: Actually read the complete principal example including closing line 723. It substitutes 279.60=P×0.03×8, simplifies to 279.60=0.24P and solves P=1165.
sources.adjustments: WorkedExamples[2](b) preserves the principal example values and formula-substitute-simplify-solve order. All existing principal questions retain their good original values and requested units/precision. The rounded principal result uses an approximation sign.

sources.observation: Actually read the complete rate example including closing line 771. It substitutes 150=5000×r×2, simplifies to 150=10000r and obtains r=0.015, then 1.5% p.a. The final source rows omit r, so their missing left sides need to be restored.
sources.adjustments: WorkedExamples[2](c) preserves the rate example values and completes the missing r labels. Rate results remain decimals until converted to percentages. All existing rate questions and options retain their good original values. Quiz q5 distractor $1440 now correctly describes omission of time. Rounded rate results use approximation rather than exact equality.

sources.locator: Supplemental native read: given total amount, I=A-P before solving time
sources.observation: Actually read lines 939–950. The text explicitly instructs I=A-P when total A is given. Its identifiable two-part practice grows $18000 to $22320, finds interest $4320, then uses 6% p.a. to find time 4 years. This supports the preliminary subtraction used in site rate/time questions.
sources.adjustments: WorkedExamples[3] adapts the original supported two-part task from $18000/$22320 to $3600/$4464, keeping 6% p.a. and 4 years. It shows I=864 before substituting and simplifying 864=216n. Site mastery and quiz total-given questions use the same extra subtraction stage without replacing the taught equation-solving method.
